text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

text.text: Ankle fractures represent the most common type of intra-articular fracture in weight-bearing joints.1 These injuries present a multitude of classifications and degree of severity. The Ortholoc 2 Ankle Fracture Low Profile System combines a complete selection of indication specific implants and instruments with an advanced andversatile locked plate technology, providing a comprehensive single tray solution to these complex indications.

text_2119240282.text:
Key features

Completely redesigned to address the anatomy

  • Offset syndesmotic and lateral fibula plates allow for precise syndesmotic fixation
  • Versatile, low-profile plate designs are Type II anodized, pairing increased strength with minimal construct prominence
  • System features a wide range of plates including hook, medial & posterior tibia, 1/3 tubular and syndesmosis plates

text_697779097.text:
Ortholoc 2 LP Ankle Fracture plates

Gravity Synchfix is compatible with plates from the Ortholoc 2 LP Ankle Fracture Plating System. The system includes a Syndesmosis Plate and a Lateral Fibula Plate that both come in Straight and Offset options for the syndesmotic plate holes.

Screws and instrumentation

2.7mm locking screw

  • On axis and polyaxial locking capability'
  • Cortical thread
  • 2.0mm pre-drill
  • 10 - 18mm lengths
  • Color code: grey

3.5mm locking screw

  • On axis and polyaxial locking capability
  • Cortical thread
  • 2.8mm pre-drill
  • 10 - 60mm lengths
  • Color code: purple

3.5mm low-profile screw

  • On axis and polyaxial locking capability
  • Cortical thread
  • 2.5mm pre-drill
  • 10 - 60mm lengths
  • Color code: bronze

3.5mm cortical bone screw

  • Cortical thread
  • Fully threaded
  • 2.5mm pre-drill
  • 10 - 60mm lengths
  • Color code: bronze

4.0mm cortical bone screw

  • Cortical thread
  • Fully threaded
  • 2.8mm pre-drill
  • 40 - 60mm lengths
  • Color code: gold

4.0mm cancellous bone screw

  • Cancellous thread
  • Fully threaded
  • 2.5mm pre-drill
  • 10 - 60mm lengths
  • Color code: green

4.0mm cancellous bone screw

  • Cancellous thread
  • Partially threaded
  • 2.5mm pre-drill
  • 20 - 60mm lengths
  • Color code: green

4.0mm cannulated bone screw
  • Cancellous thread
  • Partially threaded
  • Cannulated design (1.4mm K-wire)
  • 3.0mm pre-drill
  • 20 - 60mm lengths
  • Color code: blue

Bone screw washers

Washers are intended to prevent a screw head from breaking through the cortex of the bone by distributing the forces/load over a large area.
